preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each array is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) for a in arrays)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
Total number of elements across all arrays does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(score, int) and score >= 0 for score in output)
postconditions.description: Each output score is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(max_score == max(sum(a[i:i+a_i]) for i in range(n)) for max_score, n, a in zip(output, ns, arrays))
postconditions.description: Each output score is the maximum score achievable by starting at any index in the array.
